underdog.heading: Why Oregon can keep it close
bullets: Oregon is the better football team by 1.7 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 55% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-1.7 pts).
Depth: Oregon 54.3 (#15 of 133) vs USC 53.5 (#90 of 133) — 75 places on the national board.

Defensive line: Oregon 54.6 (#48 of 133) vs USC 49.9 (#103 of 133) — 55 places on the national board.
The outcome range is 15.1 points wide at one sigma — p10 -20.6 to p90 +23.4 for USC, so a projection of +2.4 still produces results a long way either side of it.
